create table if not exists raw_sources (
  id text primary key,
  user_id text not null,
  raw_text text not null,
  surrounding_context text,
  source_type text not null constraint raw_sources_source_type_enum_check check (source_type in ('web', 'desktop_app', 'agent', 'manual')),
  source_platform text,
  source_app text,
  source_title text,
  source_url text,
  captured_at text not null,
  metadata_json text not null default '{}',
  processing_status text not null default 'pending'
    constraint raw_sources_processing_status_enum_check check (processing_status in ('pending', 'processing', 'done', 'failed')),
  error_reason text,
  created_at text not null
);
create index if not exists raw_sources_user_idx on raw_sources (user_id, created_at);

create table if not exists knowledge_nodes (
  id text primary key,
  user_id text not null,
  title text not null constraint knowledge_nodes_title_length_check check (length(trim(title)) between 1 and 200),
  summary text,
  node_type text not null default 'topic',
  parent_id text references knowledge_nodes (id) on delete restrict,
  status text not null default 'active'
    constraint knowledge_nodes_status_enum_check check (status in ('active', 'archived', 'needs_review')),
  confidence real constraint knowledge_nodes_confidence_range_check
    check (confidence is null or (confidence between 0 and 1)),
  embedding_model text,
  embedding_status text not null default 'none'
    constraint knowledge_nodes_embedding_status_enum_check check (embedding_status in ('none', 'ready', 'failed')),
  mastery_level text not null default 'collected'
    constraint knowledge_nodes_mastery_level_enum_check check (mastery_level in ('collected', 'organized', 'understood', 'explainable', 'applicable', 'mastered')),
  created_at text not null,
  updated_at text not null,
  constraint knowledge_nodes_not_self_parent_check check (parent_id is null or parent_id <> id)
);
create index if not exists knowledge_nodes_parent_idx on knowledge_nodes (user_id, parent_id);
create index if not exists knowledge_nodes_title_idx on knowledge_nodes (user_id, title);

create table if not exists knowledge_items (
  id text primary key,
  user_id text not null,
  raw_source_id text not null references raw_sources (id) on delete restrict,
  normalized_text text not null,
  summary text,
  confidence real not null constraint knowledge_items_confidence_range_check check (confidence between 0 and 1),
  status text not null default 'active'
    constraint knowledge_items_status_enum_check check (status in ('active', 'merged', 'archived')),
  is_ai_derived integer not null default 1 check (is_ai_derived in (0, 1)),
  embedding_model text,
  embedding_status text not null default 'none'
    constraint knowledge_items_embedding_status_enum_check check (embedding_status in ('none', 'ready', 'failed')),
  parent_candidate_node_id text references knowledge_nodes (id) on delete set null,
  parent_confidence real constraint knowledge_items_parent_confidence_range_check
    check (parent_confidence is null or (parent_confidence between 0 and 1)),
  created_at text not null,
  updated_at text not null
);
create index if not exists knowledge_items_source_idx on knowledge_items (user_id, raw_source_id, created_at);

create table if not exists knowledge_edges (
  id text primary key,
  user_id text not null,
  from_node_id text not null references knowledge_nodes (id) on delete cascade,
  to_node_id text not null references knowledge_nodes (id) on delete cascade,
  relation_type text not null
    constraint knowledge_edges_relation_type_enum_check check (relation_type in ('part_of', 'prerequisite_of', 'similar_to', 'contrast_with', 'causes', 'implements', 'example_of', 'supports', 'contradicts', 'derived_from')),
  confidence real constraint knowledge_edges_confidence_range_check
    check (confidence is null or (confidence between 0 and 1)),
  source text not null,
  created_at text not null,
  constraint knowledge_edges_no_self_loop_check check (from_node_id <> to_node_id)
);
create unique index if not exists knowledge_edges_upsert_idx
  on knowledge_edges (user_id, from_node_id, to_node_id, relation_type);
create index if not exists knowledge_edges_node_idx on knowledge_edges (user_id, from_node_id, to_node_id);

create table if not exists item_node_links (
  id text primary key,
  user_id text not null,
  item_id text not null references knowledge_items (id) on delete cascade,
  node_id text not null references knowledge_nodes (id) on delete cascade,
  relation_type text not null default 'primary'
    constraint item_node_links_relation_type_enum_check check (relation_type in ('primary', 'example_of', 'supports')),
  confidence real not null constraint item_node_links_confidence_range_check check (confidence between 0 and 1),
  created_at text not null
);
create unique index if not exists item_node_links_upsert_idx on item_node_links (item_id, node_id);
create index if not exists item_node_links_node_idx on item_node_links (user_id, node_id);

create table if not exists version_records (
  id text primary key,
  user_id text not null,
  entity_type text not null
    constraint version_records_entity_type_enum_check check (entity_type in ('knowledge_node', 'knowledge_item', 'raw_source')),
  entity_id text not null,
  operation text not null
    constraint version_records_operation_enum_check check (operation in ('create', 'rename', 'move', 'reparent', 'merge', 'split', 'archive', 'restore')),
  before_json text not null default '{}',
  after_json text not null default '{}',
  actor text not null,
  created_at text not null
);
create index if not exists version_records_user_idx on version_records (user_id, created_at);
create index if not exists version_records_entity_idx on version_records (user_id, entity_id);

create table if not exists conversations (
  id text primary key,
  user_id text not null,
  node_id text references knowledge_nodes (id) on delete cascade,
  scope text not null constraint conversations_scope_enum_check check (scope in ('current_node', 'section', 'tree', 'whole_library')),
  title text,
  context_summary text,
  token_estimate integer,
  created_at text not null,
  updated_at text not null
);
create index if not exists conversations_user_idx on conversations (user_id, updated_at);

create table if not exists conversation_messages (
  id text primary key,
  conversation_id text not null references conversations (id) on delete cascade,
  role text not null
    constraint conversation_messages_role_enum_check check (role in ('system', 'user', 'assistant')),
  content text not null,
  context_node_id text,
  created_at text not null
);
create index if not exists conversation_messages_list_idx
  on conversation_messages (conversation_id, created_at);

-- One row per embedded entity. A local file must be able to hold several models over time, so the
-- width travels with the vector and search refuses to mix.
create table if not exists vectors (
  owner_type text not null check (owner_type in ('knowledge_item', 'knowledge_node')),
  owner_id text not null,
  user_id text not null,
  model_id text,
  dimension integer not null check (dimension > 0),
  normalization text not null default 'unnormalized'
    check (normalization in ('unnormalized', 'l2')),
  source_hash text,
  builder_version text,
  embedding blob not null,
  created_at text not null,
  updated_at text not null,
  primary key (owner_type, owner_id)
) without rowid;
create index if not exists vectors_owner_idx on vectors (user_id, owner_type, dimension);

-- FTS5 over pre-split terms rather than over raw text: the default tokenizers treat a CJK run as one
-- token, which cannot match a two-character Chinese query. tokenize() from @noltri/shared emits
-- bigrams for CJK runs and whole words for latin, and those terms are what gets indexed here. The
-- untouched text stays in knowledge_items / knowledge_nodes.
create virtual table if not exists keyword_index using fts5(
  entity_id unindexed,
  entity_type unindexed,
  user_id unindexed,
  tokens,
  tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2'
);

create table if not exists research_projects (
  id text primary key,
  user_id text not null,
  name text not null,
  description text,
  status text not null default 'active'
    constraint research_projects_status_enum_check check (status in ('active', 'archived', 'completed')),
  created_at text not null,
  updated_at text not null
);
create index if not exists research_projects_user_idx on research_projects (user_id, created_at);

create table if not exists research_charters (
  id text primary key,
  project_id text not null references research_projects (id) on delete cascade,
  user_id text not null,
  working_title text not null,
  research_topic text,
  research_problem text,
  research_gap text,
  research_questions_text text,
  core_contribution text,
  theoretical_lens text,
  research_context text,
  unit_of_analysis text,
  research_method text,
  target_article_type text,
  target_journal text,
  research_boundary text,
  claim_boundary text,
  current_stage text,

  updated_at text not null
);
create unique index if not exists research_charters_project_uq on research_charters (project_id);

create table if not exists research_questions (
  id text primary key,
  project_id text not null references research_projects (id) on delete cascade,

  question_code text not null,
  question_text text not null,

    constraint research_questions_status_enum_check check (status in ('open', 'answered', 'revised', 'dropped')),
  rationale text,
  related_method text,

  updated_at text not null
);

create table if not exists research_evidence (
  id text primary key,
  project_id text not null references research_projects (id) on delete cascade,
  user_id text not null,
  type text not null constraint research_evidence_type_enum_check check (type in ('literature', 'dataset', 'analysis_result', 'figure', 'table', 'interview', 'expert_judgement', 'document', 'note', 'external_source', 'other')),
  title text not null,
  description text,
  source_reference text,
  source_location text,

create index if not exists research_evidence_list_idx on research_evidence (user_id, project_id, created_at);

create table if not exists research_claims (

  claim_code text not null,
  claim_text text not null,
  claim_type text not null

    constraint research_claims_status_enum_check check (status in ('draft', 'proposed', 'confirmed', 'revised', 'dropped')),
  confidence real not null default 0 constraint research_claims_confidence_range_check
    check (confidence between 0 and 1),
  boundary text,
  created_at text not null,
  updated_at text not null
);
create index if not exists research_claims_list_idx on research_claims (user_id, project_id, created_at);

create table if not exists research_manuscript_sections (
  id text primary key,
  project_id text not null references research_projects (id) on delete cascade,
  user_id text not null,
  section_name text not null,

  updated_at text not null
);

create table if not exists research_entity_relations (
  id text primary key,
  project_id text not null references research_projects (id) on delete cascade,
  user_id text not null,
  source_type text not null
    constraint research_entity_relations_source_type_enum_check
      check (source_type in ('research_project', 'research_charter', 'research_question', 'evidence', 'claim', 'research_decision', 'research_change', 'drift_finding', 'manuscript_section')),
  source_id text not null,
  relation_type text not null
    constraint research_entity_relations_relation_type_enum_check
      check (relation_type in ('supports', 'partially_supports', 'contradicts', 'qualifies', 'contextualizes', 'answers', 'appears_in', 'changes', 'affects', 'relates_to')),
  target_type text not null
    constraint research_entity_relations_target_type_enum_check
      check (target_type in ('research_project', 'research_charter', 'research_question', 'evidence', 'claim', 'research_decision', 'research_change', 'drift_finding', 'manuscript_section')),
  target_id text not null,
  note text,
  created_at text not null

create unique index if not exists research_entity_relations_quintuple_uq
  on research_entity_relations (user_id, project_id, source_type, source_id, relation_type, target_type, target_id);
create index if not exists research_entity_relations_list_idx
  on research_entity_relations (user_id, project_id, created_at);

create table if not exists research_decisions (
  id text primary key,

  rejected_alternatives text,

create table if not exists research_changes (
  id text primary key,
  project_id text not null references research_projects (id) on delete cascade,

create table if not exists research_drift_findings (
  id text primary key,
  project_id text not null references research_projects (id) on delete cascade,
  user_id text not null,
  drift_type text not null constraint research_drift_findings_drift_type_enum_check
    check (drift_type in ('rq_drift', 'contribution_drift', 'evidence_drift', 'causality_drift', 'method_drift', 'journal_drift')),

    check (severity in ('info', 'warning', 'critical')),
  description text not null,
  source_entity_type text
    constraint research_drift_findings_source_entity_type_enum_check
    check (source_entity_type is null or source_entity_type in ('research_project', 'research_charter', 'research_question', 'evidence', 'claim', 'research_decision', 'research_change', 'drift_finding', 'manuscript_section')),
  source_entity_id text,
  target_entity_type text
    constraint research_drift_findings_target_entity_type_enum_check
    check (target_entity_type is null or target_entity_type in ('research_project', 'research_charter', 'research_question', 'evidence', 'claim', 'research_decision', 'research_change', 'drift_finding', 'manuscript_section')),
  target_entity_id text,
  reason text,
  recommended_action text,
  status text not null default 'open'
    constraint research_drift_findings_status_enum_check check (status in ('open', 'acknowledged', 'resolved', 'dismissed')),
  created_at text not null,
  updated_at text not null
);
create index if not exists research_drift_findings_list_idx
  on research_drift_findings (user_id, project_id, created_at);

create table if not exists research_review_marks (
  id text primary key,
  project_id text not null references research_projects (id) on delete cascade,
  user_id text not null,
  entity_type text not null constraint research_review_marks_entity_type_enum_check

create table if not exists capture_assets (
  user_id text not null,
  asset_id text not null,
  session_id text not null,
  mime_type text not null check (mime_type in ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp', 'image/gif')),
  sha256 text not null check (length(sha256) = 64),
  byte_length integer not null check (byte_length > 0 and byte_length <= 20971520),
  bytes blob not null,
  created_at text not null,
  primary key (user_id, asset_id)
) without rowid;
create index if not exists capture_assets_session_idx on capture_assets (user_id, session_id, created_at);

create table if not exists capture_batches (
  user_id text not null,
  batch_id text not null,
  session_id text not null,
  payload_hash text not null check (length(payload_hash) = 64),
  created_at text not null,
  updated_at text not null,
  primary key (user_id, batch_id)
) without rowid;
create index if not exists capture_batches_user_idx on capture_batches (user_id, created_at);

create table if not exists capture_batch_items (
  user_id text not null,
  batch_id text not null,
  request_id text not null,
  user_order integer not null check (user_order >= 0),
  kind text not null check (kind in ('text', 'image', 'composite')),
  status text not null check (status in ('queued', 'assets_saved', 'processing', 'needs_review', 'done', 'failed')),
  request_json text not null,
  raw_source_id text,
  duplicate integer not null default 0 check (duplicate in (0, 1)),
  retryable integer not null default 0 check (retryable in (0, 1)),
  error_reason text,
  updated_at text not null,
  primary key (user_id, batch_id, request_id),
  unique (user_id, batch_id, user_order),
  foreign key (user_id, batch_id) references capture_batches (user_id, batch_id) on delete cascade
) without rowid;
create index if not exists capture_batch_items_status_idx
  on capture_batch_items (user_id, batch_id, status, user_order);
